entries.prompt: A confident adult male in winter menswear is captured in a three-quarter length, candid street-style stride from head to mid-shin, centered in the frame with his left leg crossed forward and his torso slightly twisted toward the camera. He has dark brown hair with warm highlights, tapered above the ears with a wavy, three-to-four-inch textured top swept back from a subtle left part, showing natural flyaways and a glossy finish, paired with a groomed short boxed beard, neutral closed lips, relaxed eyebrows, and dark sunglasses. He wears a cream off-white wool bomber jacket (#EAE6DF) featuring a beige shearling collar, layered over a warm taupe brown mock-neck sweater (#7D6B5D) and charcoal gray tailored trousers (#5A5856). Both hands are clad in dark brown leather gloves; his left hand is partially tucked into his trouser pocket revealing a wristwatch at the cuff, while his right arm swings outward to the left for balance with naturally curled fingers. Behind him, a shallow-depth urban building facade splits the background asymmetrically: the left third features a weathered, cool slate gray rusticated stone pillar (#62686E) with horizontal mortar joints and vertical chiseled tooling marks, separated by a dark vertical metal drainpipe with mounting brackets from a smooth, matte deep slate masonry wall (#1B2026) occupying the right two-thirds. Hard, highly directional golden sunlight from a low-angle source 45 degrees to the left sculpts the scene with high contrast, placing strong specular highlights on his right sleeve, shearling collar, forehead, cheekbone, and the left stone pillar, while casting harsh-edged deep black and slate shadows across the right side of his face, torso, and the background wall, softened only by subtle cool daylight ambient fill and a diagonal slash of light at the bottom right. Shot straight-on at eye-to-chest level in the style of classic European menswear street photography using an 85mm lens at f/2.8, 1/1000s shutter speed, and ISO 200, this realistic digital photograph exhibits a medium depth of field with a slightly softened background, sharp fabric and stone textures, high-contrast color grading with crushed shadow blacks, warm skin tones, and subtle film grain, framed in a 9:16 vertical aspect ratio.

entries.author: derek_wall90176
entries.title: 拉片机关纸剧场艺术图模板
entries.note: 模板提示词，替换【主题】【主体】等占位符。
entries.prompt:
生成一张独立的3:4竖幅“拉片机关纸剧场”艺术图，不要拼图、步骤图或前后对照。
主题：【主题】。主角：【主体】。舞台由【场景】构成，只有一个明确的单动作：【单动作】。
用真实纸艺模型的摄影质感表现：厚卡纸纤维、整齐切边、轻微折痕、层叠纸片之间真实的细软阴影；背景为温暖的浅米白，主配色为【配色】，颜色克制。

机关采用最简单的直线滑片结构：只有一个拉片、一个承载主角的滑动件、一个固定导槽，不使用齿轮或复杂连杆。拉片位于【拉片位置】，拉片与主角同向直线移动。让拉片、穿过导槽的连续纸条、与主角连接的位置都能看清。前景纸片局部遮住滑动件，但必须留出一段可见连接，不能把拉片画成孤立装饰；纸条不可穿透其他纸层。画面只表现主角位移到一半的一个瞬间，不重复主角、不画残影，不暗示静态图片真的能互动。
构图：【构图】。纸剧场、底座和拉片全部完整收入画内，四周留出边距。用高端独立杂志的克制编排，侧上方柔光，近距离仍能辨认纸材，拒绝塑料感和炫光。

UNIVERSAL PHOTO-TO-3D PAPER-CUT EDITORIAL POSTER PROMPT

Use the uploaded image as the primary and exclusive visual reference. Automatically identify the main subject, environment, objects, colors, lighting, composition, and distinctive details. Transform it into a premium, photorealistic 3:4 vertical editorial poster combining realistic photography with an elaborate three-dimensional layered paper-cut book illustration.

OVERALL COMPOSITION:

Create two vertically integrated sections with a seamless transition, without white lines, borders, frames, or visible gaps.

TOP SECTION — ORIGINAL PHOTOGRAPH:

Preserve the uploaded photograph in its original photographic appearance. Maintain the exact subject, pose, environment, colors, lighting, perspective, and fine details. Do not redraw, stylize, replace, or modify the original photograph. Keep the scene visually rich and realistic.

BOTTOM SECTION — 3D OPEN PAPER-CUT BOOK:

Create a beautifully opened, antique ivory-beige hardcover book occupying the lower half of the composition. The book should feature multiple thick, individually visible pages with realistic stacked edges, slightly curled corners, and natural paper texture.

Inside the open book, recreate the exact same subject and environment through intricate, multi-layered 3D paper-cut artwork. Include a large central cutout window revealing the scene, surrounded by delicate hand-cut silhouettes and overlapping paper layers. Preserve the original photograph's colors, recognizable details, and overall atmosphere.

Add contextually appropriate decorative elements such as stars, clouds, trees, flowers, mountains, buildings, or other environmental details depending on the uploaded image. Use realistic paper depth, carefully cut edges, subtle folds, soft side lighting, and natural shadows to create a convincing pop-up book effect.

EDITORIAL TYPOGRAPHY:

Place an elegant vintage parchment banner across the upper portion of the open book. Add a short, meaningful poetic sentence in Traditional Chinese inspired by the photograph, with a smaller English translation directly underneath. Include fine horizontal divider lines and subtle decorative ornaments around the typography.

Ensure the Chinese characters are correctly rendered and visually balanced.

VISUAL STYLE:

Warm vintage paper aesthetic, antique ivory and champagne-beige tones, sophisticated editorial art direction, intricate paper engineering, realistic layered cutouts, delicate handcrafted details, dimensional shadows, soft cinematic lighting, and premium photorealistic textures.

IMPORTANT REQUIREMENTS:

- The original photograph must remain untouched in the upper section.
- The lower illustration must depict the exact same subject and scene.
- Maintain visual continuity between photography and paper-cut artwork.
- Make the book look physically realistic, with visible thickness, layered pages, and genuine cutout depth.
- Avoid flat illustrations, cartoon aesthetics, artificial plastic textures, and excessive decorations.
- Adapt the Chinese poetic headline and decorative elements to the uploaded subject rather than using a fixed theme.

FINAL RESULT: A sophisticated 3:4 vertical vintage editorial poster that seamlessly combines an original realistic photograph with an elaborate three-dimensional, layered paper-cut interpretation presented inside an antique open book.

【发型与发饰——核心】

极其浓密蓬松的奶油铂金色及腰长发，带有浅香槟金、象牙白金和淡银灰色反光。

两侧长发自然披散在肩膀与胸前，呈现柔和松散的大波浪卷，发尾具有自然层次。

画面右侧头发佩戴两枚精致的白色蝴蝶结与珍珠金属发夹，部分长发自然收拢至耳后。

保留细小独立发丝、自然碎发与柔和光泽，避免僵硬假发质感。

【服装与首饰】

身穿奶油白色、浅象牙色露肩修身针织连衣裙。

柔软细密的罗纹针织面料，宽松一字肩领口，肩部装饰柔软的奶油白色荷叶边褶皱。

长袖修身设计，袖口具有真实编织纹理，衣服自然贴合身体轮廓。

颈部佩戴一条精致复古金色项链，中央悬挂椭圆形金色宝石吊坠。

双耳佩戴精致的金色长款水滴形蓝宝石耳环，具有细腻金属镶嵌与自然宝石反光。

【人物姿势】

人物站在欧式古典客厅中央，身体略微侧向镜头，上半身自然挺直，肩膀放松。

一只手臂自然弯曲横放于腰腹前方，另一只手肘轻轻搭在前臂上。

抬起的手轻轻靠近下巴，手指自然弯曲，形成优雅的轻托脸部姿势。

头部略微倾斜，下巴自然收起，双眼直视镜头。

浓密铂金色长卷发沿肩膀与背部自然垂落。

【背景环境】

温暖复古的欧式客厅，深棕色木质书柜、浅米色墙壁、复古布艺沙发与木质茶几。

画面左侧有一盏散发柔和暖黄色灯光的复古落地灯，旁边是浅米色窗帘。

画面右侧为白色大理石古典壁炉，壁炉内部燃烧着温暖的橙黄色火焰。

壁炉上方摆放复古装饰品与浅色艺术画，整体空间典雅、温暖、安静。

【镜头与光影】

1:1正方形构图，等效50mm人像镜头，眼睛高度平视，人物居中，头部至腰部附近的中景构图。

柔和中性偏冷的正面补光照亮人物面部，皮肤呈现清透冷白色。

左侧落地灯与右侧壁炉产生柔和暖黄色环境光，形成自然冷暖对比。

奶油铂金色长发具有细腻金白色高光，针织裙保留真实面料纹理。

整体低饱和度、柔和对比、自然景深，轻微光学柔焦与真实相机颗粒，不过度磨皮。

【负面提示词】

动漫，插画，3D渲染，CG假脸，塑料皮肤，过度磨皮，异常大眼，过尖下巴，五官错位，假发，头发黏连，僵硬卷发，多余手指，畸形手掌，身体比例错误，针织纹理异常，服装穿模，宝石变形，壁炉火焰不自然，背景杂乱，严重过曝，强HDR，过度锐化，明显AI生成痕迹，文字，水印，LOGO，拼图。

HARBOUR: the lower half is calm black water rippling in fine horizontal chop, carrying long smeared vertical reflections that stretch down the frame.

MOON: high in the upper middle of the deep navy night sky hangs one enormous, sharply detailed full moon, its craters crisp, ringed by a soft cool blue-white halo. The sky is darkest at the top corners, paling slightly toward the horizon.

BOAT: just left of centre sits a sleek modern white motor yacht at rest, seen broadside from the front-left. Its flanks are washed in vivid neon hot coral along the hull and glowing acid-lime along the upper deck and railings, with a dark tinted glass bridge, a radar mast, a blue-lit stern platform and a line of small dark portholes.

HILLS: behind, layered dark ridgelines rise across the full width, their slopes dotted with scattered warm gold lights of hillside villas and small windows.

TOWN: along the water's edge runs a continuous waterfront promenade of low pale buildings with warm golden lit façades, arcades, windows and streetlamps. A row of moored white boats and small yachts lines the quay in dark silhouette.

REFLECTIONS: the water is split into ribbons of colour. Directly beneath the yacht run two bold vertical bands — bright hot coral and acid lime — vivid and saturated, broken into short ripples. Across the rest of the surface, the town lights throw long warm amber and orange columns, with cooler teal and deep green streaks threading between them in the lower right.

PALETTE: deep navy, near-black water, brilliant hot coral, acid lime, warm amber gold, teal green, silver-white moon. Sharp focus, high dynamic range, glossy wet highlights, clean and unmarked.

entries.prompt:
Create one realistic studio fashion contact sheet in a vertical 3:4 format, arranged as a clean 2×2 grid of four equal photographic panels with narrow ivory gutters. Use the supplied collage as a reference for the warm beige studio, copper-red hair, gentle photographic lighting, and four-panel composition. The model is an adult woman, age 28. Use the same recognizable adult face, natural freckles, hair color, dress, and lighting in all four panels.

Wardrobe throughout: an opaque soft mauve textured knit day dress, with wide shoulder straps, a modest round neckline, a relaxed straight fit, and a hem at the knees. The dress remains neatly arranged and provides the same coverage in every pose. Highlight knit fibers and natural fabric drape as a clothing catalogue would. Natural understated makeup, softly defined eyes, natural lips, realistic skin texture, and relaxed everyday expressions.

Top-left panel: an eye-level close-up portrait including her full face and one hand holding a fresh strawberry beside her cheek. Her lips are closed in a small natural smile. The strawberry has a crisp surface texture and a few water droplets. Focus on her face and the fruit together.

Top-right panel: a straightforward eye-level three-quarter-length standing portrait, facing the camera, arms resting naturally at her sides, shoulders relaxed. Show the dress fabric and silhouette clearly.

Bottom-left panel: a side-view seated portrait on the studio floor, knees gently bent, cheek resting lightly on one knee, arms relaxed around the lower legs. Arrange the skirt smoothly over her knees. Quiet, comfortable posture with a clear view of her face.

Bottom-right panel: a relaxed side-lying portrait on the same studio floor, head supported by one hand, looking toward the camera with a calm expression. Show her upper body and the continuous dress fabric in a balanced fashion-catalogue composition.

Use an off-white/beige seamless backdrop and floor, a large diffuse key light from front-left and gentle fill from the right. Match skin tone, lighting direction, hair, clothing, and color treatment across all four panels. Sharp, photorealistic commercial fashion photography, clean composition, no text, captions, panel numbers, logos, watermarks, or model names.
